data.title: 夏洛特 · 薰衣草花田的法式吊带裙
data.description: 普罗旺斯风情盛开的无垠紫色薰衣草花田，夏日微风送来沁人心脾的花香。夏洛特身穿一袭轻盈飘逸的浅黄色碎花细吊带夏日连衣裙，头戴宽檐草帽。金色的长马尾在微风中轻扬，她一手扶着草帽檐，另一手提起裙摆转过身来，脸颊泛着阳光晒出的淡粉红晕，笑容比晴空更加明媚纯真。
data.action: standing in blooming lavender field holding straw hat, yellow floral sundress with thin straps, bare shoulders, golden ponytail blowing in wind, radiant innocent smile
data.location: endless blooming lavender field under clear azure summer sky
data.lighting: dazzling warm summer sunshine illuminating purple flowers and golden hair
data.mood: sun-drenched French countryside romance, pure pastoral sweetness
data.promptProse: Standing in a blooming lavender field beneath a clear summer sky, Charlotte Dunois wears a breezy yellow floral sundress. She holds her straw hat against the wind with a radiant, sun-kissed smile.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte standing in a lavender field in a sundress, holding her straw hat with a bright smile.
